title: San Francisco Chillhop 🚆
description:
Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated San Francisco on a fresh spring morning: the Golden Gate Bridge rising out of the fog, the Transamerica Pyramid and Coit Tower over the bay, cable cars, and pastel Victorian houses with poppies and lavender out front, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Spring Showers" and "Gentle Breeze" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.

#lofi #sanfrancisco #trainride #chillhop #morningvibes
